'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Chris Schoenthal DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Schoenthal]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Username:''' imrahil327
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
